items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: My friend Jimmy Wormworth would say

ctx.x: My friend Jimmy Wormworth would say “you’ve got to come, you could work three to four nights a week here.” I’m working six and seven nights here.
You know how many times I’m working Saturday? Come on.
